topics.title: Neural system and the human neural system

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the organisation of the neural system differs among Hydra, insects and vertebrates.
Distinguish the central and peripheral neural systems and afferent and efferent nerve fibres.
Distinguish the somatic and autonomic divisions of the peripheral neural system by the organs they serve.
Identify the cell body, dendrites, axon and synaptic knobs of a neuron and their roles.
Classify neurons as multipolar, bipolar or unipolar and state where each is found.
Distinguish myelinated and non-myelinated nerve fibres and state where each occurs.

topics.title: Generation and conduction of nerve impulse

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how ion permeability and the sodium-potassium pump polarise the resting axonal membrane.
Explain depolarisation by Na+ influx and repolarisation by K+ efflux during an action potential.
Explain how local current flow conducts an action potential along an axon.
Describe the structure and speed of impulse transmission at electrical synapses.
Explain the sequence of events in impulse transmission across a chemical synapse.

topics.title: Central neural system: brain protection and forebrain

concepts.learning_objective: State the functions of the brain and name the cranial meninges in order.
Describe the cerebral hemispheres, corpus callosum, cerebral cortex and white matter.
State the functions of the thalamus, hypothalamus and limbic system.
Describe the location of the midbrain, the cerebral aqueduct and the corpora quadrigemina.
State the structure and functions of the pons, cerebellum and medulla oblongata.
Identify the parts of the brain stem and predict the effects of damage to it.
